## Summary

Created `tests/org/apache/commons/lang/time/FastDateFormatAgentTest.java` — a self-contained JUnit 4 test class (matching the `junit-4.12` / `junit-4.7` jars in `lib/`), in the same package as the class under test.

### Coverage (all grounded in `api/` javadoc)

| Area | Tests |
|---|---|
| **Style constants** | `FULL/LONG/MEDIUM/SHORT` == `0/1/2/3` (from `constant-values.html`) and align with `DateFormat` |
| **`getInstance` factories** | no-arg defaults (pattern non-empty, default TZ/locale); pattern round-trips via `getPattern()`; stores TZ + locale; null TZ → default TZ; null locale → default locale |
| **Error cases** | invalid pattern (unterminated quote) → `IllegalArgumentException`; null pattern (1-arg and 3-arg) → `IAE`; unknown style `99` → `IAE`; `format(Object,...)` with a `String` → `IAE`, with `null` → `IAE`/`NPE` |
| **`format` correctness** | epoch in GMT → `"1970-01-01 00:00:00"`; a known instant (Unix time 1e9) → `"2001-09-09T01:46:40"`; `format(long)` / `format(Date)` / `format(Calendar)` agree for one instant; `Calendar` field values honoured |
| **`StringBuffer` overloads** | return the *same* buffer instance (`assertSame`) and *append* (pre-filled `"PRE-"` retained) for the millis/Date/Calendar and `Object` dispatch variants |
| **SimpleDateFormat compatibility** | output equals `SimpleDateFormat` across 6 instants (incl. negative); millisecond `SSS` pattern |
| **Time-zone pattern extensions** | `'Z'` → RFC822 (`+0000`/`+0800`/`-1100`); `'ZZ'` → ISO8601 (`+00:00`/`+08:00`/`-11:00`) — the javadoc's own examples |
| **Localized standard instances** | `getDateInstance` / `getTimeInstance` / `getDateTimeInstance` patterns equal `DateFormat.get*Instance(...).toPattern()` and format identically; date/time pattern ≠ bare date pattern |
| **`parseObject`** | 2-arg always returns `null`; inherited 1-arg throws `ParseException` |
| **`equals` / `hashCode` / `toString`** | identical config ⇒ equal + equal/stable hashCode; differing pattern/TZ/locale ⇒ not equal; reflexive; rejects `null` and foreign types; `toString` non-empty and mentions the pattern |
| **`getMaxLengthEstimate`** | positive and ≥ produced length |
| **`getTimeZoneOverridesCalendar`** | reported consistently (no guess at which factory sets it, since the javadoc doesn't specify) |
| **Thread-safety** | 6 threads × 400 formats of one date all yield the documented string |
